Academic project · Auditing

Auditing Case Study — Dua Coffee, Cipete

Mapped two business cycles, identified 16 potential risk points, and designed test of control and substantive test procedures. Financial statements were not examined.

Revenue cycle

10 risk points
  1. Order3 risks

Expenditure cycle

See sample risks
  • EDC payment: POS status may not match the card terminal result. Expected control: verify the EDC slip and reconcile EDC to POS every session.
  • Purchasing: mismatches between invoice, goods and PO may go undetected. Expected control: three-way matching before Finance processes the documents.
